epistemic_findings: HYPOTHESEN.md explicitly labels free-model assessments as proposals rather than findings; generated recombinations cannot become evidence, world truth or execution authority without independent evidence.
KORRELATIONEN.md preserves filename-family version chains, but suffix/version strings are not a trustworthy chronological order by themselves; provenance/timestamps/ancestry govern supersession.
LEBENSZYKLUS/KORRELATIONEN/KATALOG are derived views over the already frozen 655-document v7 corpus and do not create a second semantic-document denominator.

denominator_semantics.caveat: 661 is the concept-index artifact denominator, not the whole Drive or whole AICORE denominator. Individual raw text-file identity remains represented by the frozen v7 preprocessing/index provenance rather than a fresh provider raw-hash pass.

earned_work.reason: The 655-document concept corpus and its relation/lifecycle metadata were already semantically frozen in the prior v7 submanifest; this closure only resolves the AICORE root/index identity and epistemic class.
